observability_triage.rationale: Retention is observable as two populated zero-ohm resistor symbols and footprints, one in each power-board SDA0 and SCL0 path. Connectivity can be checked from the schematic graph and footprint presence from the PCB, without accepting a descriptive property flag.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The power-board SDA0 and SCL0 signal paths each contain exactly one populated two-pin 0 Ω series resistor with a matching PCB footprint; neither signal has a direct net bypass around its resistor.

observables.surface: dist/design.kicad_sch I2C connectivity and dist/design.kicad_pcb resistor population
setup: Identify the power-board I2C connector endpoints and internal SDA0/SCL0 endpoints.

expected_observations.subject: populated 0-ohm series resistors across SDA0 and SCL0 paths
I2C paths lacking exactly one resistor edge
direct connector-to-internal-net bypass paths avoiding the resistor
series resistor references missing from PCB footprints

determinism_controls: Derive graph edges from actual schematic pins/nets.
Treat DNP/not-fitted BOM fields as unpopulated even if a footprint exists.
Do not accept a synthetic requirement component with no pins as a resistor implementation.

setup: The model says retain but no resistor pins or PCB footprints exist.
negative_cases.action: Traverse each I2C path and join references to PCB footprints.

setup: The resistors exist but a same-net connection bypasses them.
negative_cases.action: Search for a connector-to-bus path excluding resistor edges.
